items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC36 (verifier: error for missing/unpaired/outside, warning for stale) and AC37 (append, idempotent, refuse unsafe) are covered by 30 tests; no new FR.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable or unsupported config, damaged markers, unresolved profile: reported, nothing written; verifier skips on unresolved profile.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Only the validated lint.block is spliced, as json.dumps data; atomic write; no commands, no network.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Verbatim Next 15 and Next 16 configs, CRLF, regex/template brackets, refusal cases, CLI exit codes, byte-equality idempotency.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One small file read and one lex pass.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Lib + CLI + own verifier module; build_checks.py only gains an import and one call (bloat headroom).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: eslint.config.* written by create-next-app, step 7 and the repair tool; read by the check and ESLint. Round-trip: apply output re-checked ok in tests.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: tmp_path only, no shared state, default tier.
